explication: Agent-Native is a TypeScript framework for applications that combine autonomous agents with purpose-built user interfaces. The principal workflow is that a person or agent invokes a shared action; the action applies the same validation, permissions, and implementation regardless of caller, and shared application data makes the result available across the agent and UI. The README also documents chat, authentication, context awareness, persistent agent resources, automations, teams, and PostgreSQL support. Several subsystems are represented at their enclosing package or directory because their implementation was not sampled.
